name: Photoreal Live Action: Item Product Shot
description: Image preset for a item product shot in the Photoreal Live Action look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a prop or item shot. Describe material, wear, size cue, and the one detail that makes it recognisable from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: single item centred on a plain surface, three-quarter angle, whole object visible with its key detail facing the viewer, photorealistic live-action film still, natural skin texture with pores, real fabric and material detail, true-to-life proportions, 50mm lens, motivated natural light, soft key from a window or practical lamp, neutral colour grade, gentle film grain
negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, plastic skin, oversaturated, extra fingers, distorted face, text, watermark
